artifact: um_app_seed.db tables stotra_table (121 rows) + stotra_lyrics_table (16027 rows)
rights_status: UNKNOWN - official app, no explicit licence/redistribution terms observed
notes: Broader than pure 'stotra' genre despite the table name -- includes short devotional hymns, but also multi-part recitations of larger works: Dvadasha Stotra (12 parts, group 'Dwadashastotra'/'Dwadashastotra v2'), Jitante Stotra (5 parts), Brahma Sutra Anu Bhashya excerpts (4 parts), and Sumadhva Vijaya recitation audio (groups 'Sumadhwavijaya'/'Sumadhwavijaya v2'). Each entry has per-line timing (start_ms/end_ms) for audio sync and an is_remark flag separating actual verse lines from spoken framing (e.g. closing 'iti ... stotram' announcements). Checked against dge/data/library.json before archiving: Dvadasha Stotra's MULA TEXT is already ingested from two independent sources (SarvaMula and SetuTila editions) -- this audio+lyrics data would be an audio-recitation ENRICHMENT for that existing text, not a new acquisition. Jitante Stotra and Madhwanama were not found in a quick library.json/taxonomy.json check and look like genuine gaps, but that was not an exhaustive search.
next_step: A dedicated ingestion pass, item by item, following this project's normal standard (source verification, taxonomy placement, author attribution per text) -- 121 items is real, multi-session work, not something to force through in one pass. Priority candidates: Jitante Stotra and Madhwanama if confirmed absent; Dvadasha Stotra audio as an enrichment of the existing mula text (needs a decision on where audio_url attaches to an existing grantha's metadata).
